oneLine: Sabari Constructions Technologies Limited files DRHP for an IPO on NSE Emerge.

sources.title: Sabari Constructions Technologies Limited Files DRHP With NSE Emerge

synopsis: Sabari Constructions Technologies Limited has filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus with the Emerge Platform of the National Stock Exchange of India Limited for an initial public offering. The IPO comprises a fresh issue of up to 63,00,000 equity shares with a face value of 10 rupees each, with no offer for sale component. The proceeds from the fresh issue are planned to be used to fund working capital requirements of up to 16,004.64 lakhs rupees and for general corporate purposes. GYR Capital Advisors Private Limited acts as the book running lead manager to the issue, and Purva Sharegistry (India) Private Limited serves as the registrar.
